item.title: The puzzle roguelike game, DIALOOP, is now available via Steam Early Access
item.description: "Japanese developer, Byking Inc., has announced their upcoming puzzle roguelike title, DIALOOP -Roguelite Puzzle-, has entered Early Access on Steam." - Byking Inc.

item.title: The survival base-building colony sim, Adaptory, is coming to Steam EA on January 26th, 2026
item.description: "Stormcloak Games and indie.io have announced during the Frosty Games Mini showcase that Adaptory, the indie survival base-building colony sim, will enter Early Access on Steam on January 26, 2026." - Stormcloak Games and indie.io.

item.title: The hand-painted ARPG, Travelers Refrain, is now available for the Nintendo Switch
item.description: "Red Essence Games and indie.io are thrilled to announce that Travelers Refrain, the hand-painted, music-infused action RPG, is now available on Nintendo Switch." - Red Essence Games and indie.io.

item.title: Anima: Gate of Memories I & II Remastered is now physically available for the PS5
item.description: "SelectaPlay is thrilled to announce that the stunning physical release of Anima: Gate of Memories I & II Remastered is OUT NOW for PlayStation 5." - SelectaPlay.

item.title: The co-op extraction puzzle-platformer, Frog Sqwad, is coming to Steam in 2026
item.description: "Panic Stations (the new development studio founded by veteran Fall Guys developers) are today very happy and excited to announce that their co-op extraction puzzle-platformer, Frog Sqwad, is coming to Steam in 2026" - Panic Stations.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader is now available for the Nintendo Switch 2
item.description: "By the grace of the God Emperor, Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader made landfall today on Nintendo Switch 2. After a successful launch on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox almost exactly two years ago, players on Switch 2 can now dive into the grim and opulent world of Owlcat Games acclaimed CRPG for the first time." - Owlcat Games.

item.title: New Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 content available today, including Versos Drafts level
item.description: Developer Sandfall Interactive shows appreciation to its fans with a Thank You Update at no additional cost.

item.title: Developers at Microsoft-owned Doom studio id Software form union with CWA
item.description: Employees at Doom studio id Software have voted in favour of union representation with the Communications Workers of America (CWA).

item.title: Midnight Jazz: Final Fantasy IX Tracklist And Merchandise Revealed
item.description: The tracklist for the Midnight Jazz: FINAL FANTASY IX album and more merchandise have been revealed as part of the FFIX 25th anniversary.

item.title: Ace Combat 8 Will Reportedly Have Online Co-op Mode and Crossplay
item.description: Ace Combat 8 will feature something entirely new for the franchise and that's an online co-op mode with crossplay.
